heroHeadline: AI Surpasses ER Physicians in Harvard/Science Study as Wildfire AI, Cancer Detection, and African Health AI Summit Mark Global Progress
heroSubtitle: A landmark Science publication from Harvard Medical School shows OpenAI o1 outperforming emergency room physicians (67% vs 56% diagnostic accuracy on 76 real cases). Simultaneously, Mayo Clinic's REDMOD AI detects pancreatic cancer up to 3 years earlier than specialist radiologists; AI wildfire cameras now operational across 17 US states detected 725 fires in 2025; and GITEX Future Health Africa — the continent's first dedicated health-AI summit — convened 15,000 in Casablanca around health sovereignty and equitable AI diagnostics for Africa.
footerNote: Data sourced from peer-reviewed journals (Nature, Science, The Lancet, npj Digital Medicine, Gut, Frontiers in Education), UN agencies (WHO, FAO, WFP, UNESCO, ITU), and major technology research outlets. Impact claims require independent validation; contested figures are marked.
